description: This file contains a collection of shell functions used for managing pull request merges, including checking file changes, verifying merge conditions, performing the merge with proper annotations, and cleaning up. It appears to be a script that automates the merge process of GitHub pull requests with specific logic for handling checks, conflicts, and post-merge annotations.

methods.name: is_mainline_drift_critical_path_for_merge
methods.description: Determines if a given file path is part of mainline drift critical paths based on predefined patterns.

methods.name: print_file_list_with_limit
methods.description: Prints a limited number of lines from a specified file, with a label and count, indicating if more lines exist.

methods.name: mainline_drift_requires_sync
methods.description: Checks if the mainline drift requires synchronization before merging, based on file overlap with the PR and critical path files.

methods.name: merge_verify
methods.description: Verifies that a pull request is ready for merge by checking draft status, head SHA consistency, required checks, and mainline drift.

methods.name: merge_run
methods.description: Coordinates the process of merging a pull request, including verification, annotations, performing the merge, and cleanup.
